transcription.text: What the Latter-day Saints call celestial marriage is characteristic of the Church, and is in very general practice. But of celestial marriage, plurality of wives was an incident, never an essential. We believe in a literal resurrection, and an actual hereafter, in which future states shall be recognized every sanctified and authorized relationship existing here on earth, of parent and child, brother and sister, husband and wife.
